VIVAGE •SENIOR CIVING

VIVAGE STANDARD OPERATING POLICY & PROCEDURE

Subject: COVID-19 Vaccine or Immunity Mandate Policy #HRSC. F.6744

Date Develop ed: Date Revised:

Accountab ility: Responsibility:

4 August 2021 7 August 2021

Administrator Human Resources

PURPOSE: To protect the health and safety of our residents, employees, visitors, vendors, and the community from COVID-19 infection, and in accordance with Vivage's duty to provide and maintain a workplace that is free of known hazards, we are adopting this policy to safeguard the health of our employees and their families, our customers and visitors, and the community at large from infectious diseases, such as COVID-19, that may bereduced by vaccinations. This policy will comply with all applicable laws and is based upon guidance from the CDC and local health authorities.

SCOPE: All employees are required to receive vaccinations as determined by our Chief Clinical Officer, Management Team, and Chief Medical Officer, unless a reasonable exemption is sought and approved. Employees must provide proof of being fully vaccinated or provide an approved ex emption.

PROCEDURES: All employees are eligible to obtain the vaccination for free. Employees must provide proof of vaccination before the stated deadlines to ensure their employment is not interrupted

POLICY: 1) Proof of Immunity can only be achieved by satisfying the following: a) Proof of vaccination by presenting the CDC vaccine card containing the product name/manufacturer of the vaccine, the vaccine lot number, and the date(s) received If the vaccine card mentioned herein has been lost or is otherwise unavailable, this proof may be obtained through the federal database showing the required information above.

ii

The employee must obtain this information and provide it to the Administrator within three (3) business days. Proof of vaccination will be kept in the employee's confidential medical file with human resources.

iv)

Evidence of being vaccinated must to completed no later than September 30, 2021 for the following communities: (1) Amberwood, Autumn Heights, Brook shire, Denver North, Highline, North Star, Parkview, Rowan and Uptown Evidence of being vaccinated must be completed no later October 31, 2021 for the following communties: (1) Allison, Arbor View, Aviva, Cambridge, Christopher House, Clear Creek, Corporate Office, Fairacres, Green House, Harmony Pointe, Mesa Vista, Parkmoor, Riverdale, Sierra, Summit, University Heights, Valley View, and Wheatridge Manor. (2) Holly, Colorow, Eagle Ridge, and Regent Park
